name: Pablo Lightweight Storefront Templates for WooCommerce
author: pablo rotem

sections.description:
Pablo Lightweight Storefront Templates for WooCommerce provides focused storefront styling and practical catalog controls for WooCommerce shop, product category and product tag archives.

The plugin uses standard WordPress and WooCommerce hooks, body classes and enqueued CSS. It does not replace WooCommerce PHP templates, modify core files, load remote frameworks, collect telemetry or connect to external services.

Features include:

  • Three storefront styles: Modern Cards, Minimal and Compact Catalog.
  • Separate desktop, tablet and mobile column controls.
  • Original, square, portrait and landscape image presentation.
  • Configurable accent color and card corner radius.
  • Optional equal-height product cards.
  • Options to hide the result count, sorting, ratings and sale badges.
  • No remote scripts, fonts, tracking or external APIs.
  • No WooCommerce template overrides.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect personal data, place tracking cookies, send telemetry or connect to external services.

Trademark Notice

This plugin is independently developed by pablo rotem. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by WooCommerce or Automattic. WooCommerce is a trademark of its respective owner.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open WooCommerce > Storefront Templates.
  5. Choose a style, responsive columns and catalog visibility options.
  6. Save the settings and review the shop and product taxonomy pages.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Does it replace WooCommerce template files?

No. It uses standard hooks, classes and enqueued CSS.

Does it modify original product images?

No. Image-ratio settings change presentation only. Original media files are not altered.

Does it create AMP pages?

No. The plugin does not generate AMP documents or AMP-specific markup.

Does it send data to an external service?

No. The plugin contains no telemetry, tracking or remote API integration.
